purpose: Stencil extraction from approved concept images; preview only
common: Create a clean 2D engraving STENCIL extracted from the exact attached concept art. Preserve all narrative objects, their left/right ordering, original angular Egyptian-like contour drawing, and relative spatial relationships. Convert each carved groove to a single clear solid BLACK line on perfectly uniform WHITE. Keep enclosed body/clothing/leaf/cloud interiors WHITE except tiny eyes. NO stone, slab silhouette, bevel, lighting, shadows, gray gradients, stone texture, frame, text, letters, invented runes, watermark or extra objects. Orthographic front drawing only, consistent moderately bold line weight, sharp angular junctions, clean separation of adjacent strokes. Leave 8 percent white margin around every side. This is technical shape data to project onto an actual Unity rock; do not render a rock.
